text: Amadeus QQ 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的 QQ 接入插件，通过本机 NapCat 的 OneBot HTTP 与 WebSocket 连接群聊和私聊，并为获授权的场景建立持久 DSH Session。会话可读取未读消息、等待新消息并续接当前活动，也可按权限发送文本、提及和回复。插件提供场景会话管理、连接状态、能力目录及本地 Web 管理控制台；每个场景绑定工作区并使用独立权限设置。适合希望在 DSH 中持续处理 QQ 对话的用户。使用前需自行运行并配置本机 NapCat/OneBot；插件默认不启用连接。

Amadeus QQ connects authorized QQ chats to persistent DSH Sessions through local NapCat. Sessions can read messages, wait for new ones and send permitted replies. A web console manages scenes and connection settings. NapCat must be provided locally; connection is disabled by default.
想把 QQ 群聊和私聊接进 DSH，并让每个获授权的聊天保留自己的会话。
我希望 DSH 能等待 QQ 新消息，再接着当前会话继续处理。
I want DSH to read and reply to messages in my authorized QQ chats through NapCat.
Amadeus QQ 的功能「持续会话」：为授权 QQ 场景绑定持久 DSH Session。可读取未读消息、等待新消息并续接活动，也能按权限发送文本或回复。
Amadeus QQ 的功能「场景控制台」：在 Web 控制台查看连接、工作区和授权场景，配置 NapCat 地址、Bot 与 Owner QQ 号及场景权限。
Amadeus QQ 使用前须知：消息通过配置的本机 NapCat/OneBot HTTP 与 WebSocket 接收或发送；配置的 Token 可用于授权连接，插件默认关闭连接。

@fg-lab/amadeus-qq README · What you can do：- Connect an existing local NapCat instance to authorized groups and private chats, each with a persistent DSH Session in your Workspace.
- Continue a current conversation using read, wait, mark-read and guarded sends; deduplicate delivery attempts and preserve Session history across ordinary configuration edits.
- Handle supported text, mentions, replies and media through capability-specific checks. Provider-dependent features remain conditional.
- Choose Observe, Safe Chat, Enhanced or Autonomous Social presets; trusted administrator private chats may use Owner Agent. Global denials and QQ platform permissions always apply.
- Manage account/profile operations and optional QQ Space capabilities on their separate account page. Availability depends on the actual provider and configured grants.
- Pause NapCat listening for handoff to another application. QQ owns current conversations; optional Life owns long-term wake scheduling.

@fg-lab/amadeus-qq README · What you can do：Example: authorize a test group in Observe, inspect inbound status, then select Safe Chat when ready to allow replies. Use the Web Console to inspect effective permissions instead of assuming that a preset grants every tool.

@fg-lab/amadeus-qq README · What you can do：NapCat is not bundled: this plugin does not install, log in to or host NapCat. An unconfigured installation sends nothing. Dangerous tools are not enabled by default. Memory, Life, State and Persona are optional; QQ does not grant access to their private data merely by receiving a message.

@fg-lab/amadeus-qq README · Upgrade and recovery：Back up user data before upgrading. Code, persistent user data and recovery backups are separate. Disable stops functionality; uninstall is intended to retain external data. Restoring old code alone does not reverse a database migration.

@fg-lab/amadeus-qq README · 能帮你做什么：- 将已登录的本地 NapCat 接入获授权的群聊与私聊，每个场景在指定工作区拥有独立持久 DSH 会话。
- 用读取、等待补充、标记已读和受权限约束的发送维持当前交流；去重投递，普通配置修改保留会话历史。
- 支持代码已实现的文字、@、引用及媒体能力，逐项检查权限；依赖 Provider 的功能以实际可用状态为准。
- 选择仅观察、安全聊天、增强对话或自主群友；仅可信管理员私聊可选择 Owner Agent。全局拒绝与 QQ 平台权限始终有效。
- 在独立账号页管理资料及可选 QQ 空间能力；是否可用取决于实际 Provider 与授权。
- 暂停监听以交接给其他应用。QQ 负责当前交流，可选 Life 负责长期自主唤醒。

示例：先把测试群加入仅观察模式，确认入站正常，再切换安全聊天允许回复。通过控制台查看有效权限，不要把选择预设理解为开放全部工具。

插件不包含 NapCat，不负责其安装、登录或托管。未配置时不会外发，危险工具不默认开放。Memory、Life、State、Persona 均为可选联动，收到 QQ 消息不代表获得其他插件的私有数据权限。
